[SWS_DM_00289] Configurable environmental condition check evaluates to
FALSE
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04199
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall send the NRC defined in
nrcValue
, if
the computation of the
DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula
evaluated to
FALSE
. If
nrcValue
does not define a NRC, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall send
NRC 0x22 (
kConditionsNotCorrect
).
⌋
7.3.2.6 UDS response handling
